script.title: PRICE MATCH TWIST
script.story_hook: A flyer screenshot starts a polite price match.
script.intro_zh: 一張手機截圖，引出一場有禮的比價。
script.welcome_en: Welcome! Today we ask a store to match a cheaper price. Listen for money words.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎！今天我們請商店比照別家便宜的價格。留意金錢的說法。
script.outro: A fair price starts with a polite question. Compare, ask, win. See you soon!
script.outro_zh: 公道價從有禮的一問開始。比一比、問一問、就能省。下次見！
script.practice_intro_en: Hear it again and echo every line out loud.
script.practice_intro_zh: 再聽一次，每行都大聲跟著唸。
script.char_a_description: a college-age young man with messy dark brown hair under a gray beanie, an oversized red hoodie, thin frame, black-framed glasses, scuffed sneakers
script.char_b_description: a cheerful Latina woman in her fifties with silver-streaked black hair in a neat bun, a purple blazer over a white blouse, oval name badge, small gold earrings

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Excuse me, do you match competitor ads?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪkˈskjuːz mi duː ju mætʃ kəmˈpɛtɪtɚ ædz/
dialogue.zh: 打擾一下，你們會比照別家的廣告價嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We match local paper ads. How close?
dialogue.phonetic: /wi mætʃ ˈloʊkəl ˈpeɪpɚ ædz haʊ kloʊs/
dialogue.zh: 我們比照當地的報紙廣告。差多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The same air fryer is forty-nine in town east.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə seɪm ɛɹ ˈfɹaɪɚ ɪz ˈfɔɹti naɪn ɪn taʊn ist/
dialogue.zh: 同款氣炸鍋在城東賣四十九。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Is it? Ours says fifty-nine right here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ɪt aʊɹz sɛz ˈfɪfti naɪn raɪt hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 是嗎？我們這邊標價是五十九。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I saved a screenshot — how do I show it?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ seɪvd ə ˈskɹinˌʃɑt haʊ du aɪ ʃoʊ ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我存了截圖，要怎麼給您看？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, pull it up on your phone, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt pʊl ɪt ʌp ɑn jʊɹ foʊn pliːz/
dialogue.zh: 好，請把手機打開給我看看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here's the page from yesterday's paper.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪɹz ðə peɪdʒ fɚ ˈjɛstɚˌdeɪz ˈpeɪpɚ/
dialogue.zh: 這是昨天報紙的那一頁。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, if the item is exactly the same.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɪf ði ˈaɪtəm ɪz ɪɡˈzæktli ðə seɪm/
dialogue.zh: 可以，只要商品完全一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, same brand and even the same color.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk seɪm blænd ənd ˈivən ðə seɪm ˈkʌlɚ/
dialogue.zh: 您看，同一個品牌連顏色都一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: First — is this ad still good today?
dialogue.phonetic: /fɜɹst ɪz ðɪs æd stɪl ɡʊd təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 首先，這廣告今天還有效嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, but it ends tonight, actually.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs bət ɪt ɛndz təˈnaɪt ˈæktʃuəli/
dialogue.zh: 有，不過今晚就到期了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, let me take one look.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ lɛt mi teɪk wʌn lʊk/
dialogue.zh: 好，我看一眼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See? Forty-nine, that's the price there.
dialogue.phonetic: /si ˈfɔɹti naɪn ðæts ðə praɪs ðɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 看到沒？那邊賣四十九。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hmm, ours is the six-quart model.
dialogue.phonetic: /həm ˈaʊɹz ɪz ðə sɪks kwɔɹt ˈmɑdəl/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，我們這台是六夸脫的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh — the ad is the eight-quart!
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ði æd ɪz ði eɪt kwɔɹt/
dialogue.zh: 噢——廣告上是八夸脫的！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ah, there's the difference, then.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑ ðɛɹz ðə ˈdɪfɹəns ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 啊，差別就在這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So same model means same size, I see.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ seɪm ˈmɑdəl minz seɪm saɪz aɪ si/
dialogue.zh: 所以同款就得同容量，我懂了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What's the model number on their page?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌts ðə ˈmɑdəl ˈnʌmbɚ ɑn ðɛr peɪdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 他們那一頁的型號是多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It ends in eight-oh-two... oh.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɛndz ɪn eɪt oʊ tu oʊ/
dialogue.zh: 尾號是八零二……噢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ours ends in six-oh-two, so no match.
dialogue.phonetic: /aʊɹz ɛndz ɪn sɪks oʊ tu soʊ noʊ mætʃ/
dialogue.zh: 我們這台尾號六零二，所以無法比照。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ah, I missed that. So this is fifty-nine?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑ aɪ mɪst ðæt soʊ ðɪs ɪz ˈfɪfti naɪn/
dialogue.zh: 啊，是我沒注意到。這台五十九？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Still, we do have the eight-quart too.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɪl wi du hæv ði eɪt kwɔɹt tu/
dialogue.zh: 不過，我們也有八夸脫的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Really? Is that cheaper than their ad?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɹɪli ɪz ðæt ˈtʃipɚ ðæn ðɛr æd/
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎？那個會比廣告便宜嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sixty-four — more than their price today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪksti fɔɹ mɔɹ ðæn ðɛɹ praɪs təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 六十四——比他們的廣告價還貴。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, but the six-quart suits me better.
dialogue.phonetic: /həm bət ðə sɪks kwɔɹt suːts mi ˈbɛɾɚ/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，可是六夸脫更適合我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eight quarts takes up a lot of space.
dialogue.phonetic: /eɪt kwɔɹts teɪks ʌp ə lɑt əv speɪs/
dialogue.zh: 八夸脫很佔空間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: True, my counter space is tiny.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɹu maɪ ˈkaʊntɚ speɪs ɪz ˈtaɪni/
dialogue.zh: 也是，我家流理台很小。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The six-quart fits in a drawer, by the way.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə sɪks kwɔɹt fɪts ɪn ə ˈdɹɔɚ baɪ ðə weɪ/
dialogue.zh: 對了，六夸脫收得進抽屜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, I'll take the six-quart, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ aɪl teɪk ðə sɪks kwɔɹt pliːz/
dialogue.zh: 好，請給我六夸脫的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart choice. It comes with a recipe card.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑɹt tʃɔɪs ɪt kʌmz wɪð ə ˈɹɛsəpi kɑɹd/
dialogue.zh: 聰明的選擇。附一張食譜卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Free with the purchase or extra?
dialogue.phonetic: /fɹi wɪð ðə ˈpɜɹtʃəs ɔɹ ˈɛkstɹə/
dialogue.zh: 是買就送，還是要加錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Free inside the box, already packed.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɹi ɪnˈsaɪd ðə bɑks ɔlˈɛɾɪ pækt/
dialogue.zh: 免費，已經放在盒子裡了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does this brand have a warranty too?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðɪs blænd hæv ə ˈwɔɹənɾi tu/
dialogue.zh: 這個品牌也有保固嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, two years for parts and repair.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs tu jɪɹz fɚ pɑɹts ənd rɪˈpɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 有，零件與維修保固兩年。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Their store is far — that's why I'm here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛɹ stɔɹ ɪz fɑɹ ðæts waʊ aɪm hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 他們家店很遠，所以我來這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good move. Anything else you want to know?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd muv ˈɛniˌθɪŋ ɛls ju wɑnt tə noʊ/
dialogue.zh: 聰明。還想問什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it quieter than my old one?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ɪt ˈkwaɪɾɚ ðæn maɪ oʊld wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 比我舊的那台安靜嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Quieter than a coffee grinder, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkwaɪɾɚ ðæn ə ˈkɔˌfi ˈɡɹaɪndɚ ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 老實說，比磨豆機還安靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sold! Oh no — this box has a big dent.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊld oʊ noʊ ðɪs bɑks hæz ə bɪɡ dɛnt/
dialogue.zh: 買了！噢不，這盒子有個大凹陷。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That dent came from our warehouse, not you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt dɛnt keɪm fɚ ˈaʊɚ ˈwɛɹˌhaʊs nɑt ju/
dialogue.zh: 那是我們倉庫的舊傷，不怪您。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay. Does that change the price at all?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ dʌz ðæt tʃeɪndʒ ðə praɪs ət ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 了解，那價位會因此調整嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes — a dented box gets a small discount.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ə ˈdɛntəd bɑks ɡɛts ə smɔl ˈdɪskaʊnt/
dialogue.zh: 會，盒子破損有小折扣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice. How much off, if I may ask?
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs haʊ mʌtʃ ɑf ɪf aɪ meɪ æsk/
dialogue.zh: 好，請問可以折多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Five dollars off — let me check my boss.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪv ˈdɑləz ɑf lɛt mi tʃɛk maɪ bɔs/
dialogue.zh: 折五塊，我問一下主管。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Of course, take a minute.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv ˈkɔɹs teɪk ə ˈmɪnɪt/
dialogue.zh: 當然，您慢慢來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, she says yes — five off today.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ʃi sɛz jɛs faɪv ɑf təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 好，她答應今天折五塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wonderful! So what's the final price?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwʌndɚfəl soʊ wʌts ðə ˈfaɪnəl praɪs/
dialogue.zh: 太好了！最後多少錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fifty-four plus tax — that dent helped you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɪfti fɔɹ plʌs tæks ðæt dɛnt hɛlpt ju/
dialogue.zh: 五十四加稅——那個凹陷反而幫了您。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more thing — do you take my app card?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔɹ θɪŋ du ju teɪk maɪ æp kɑɹd/
dialogue.zh: 還有一件事，收手機裡的卡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, tap or insert, either is fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs tæp ɔɹ ɪnˈsɜɹt ˈiːðɚ ɪz faɪn/
dialogue.zh: 收的，貼一下或插卡都行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, let's check out — I'm in a hurry.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜɹfɪkt lɛts tʃɛk aʊt aɪm ɪn ə ˈhɜɹi/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，請快一點結帳，我趕時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One second, adding the air fryer now.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈsɛkənd ˈædɪŋ ði ɛɹ ˈfɹaɪɚ naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 等一下，正在輸入氣炸鍋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you sell the paper liners here?
dialogue.phonetic: /duː ju sɛl ðə ˈpeɪpɚ ˈlaɪnɚz hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 這裡有賣專用紙墊嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the little red packs — grab one there.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə ˈlɪɾəl ɹædz ɡɹæb wʌn ðɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 有，紅色小包裝，拿一包去結帳。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need to join anything for this price?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid tə dʒɔɪn ˈɛniˌθɪŋ fɚ ðɪs praɪs/
dialogue.zh: 這個價位要先加入什麼嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the app account is free to start.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ði æp əˈkaʊnt ɪz fɹi tə stɑɹt/
dialogue.zh: 不用，手機會員免費開通。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What a deal — today's my lucky day.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ə dil təˈdeɪz maɪ ˈlʌki deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 真划算，今天運氣真好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: All done — we emailed your receipt.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔl dʌn wi ˈiːˌmeɪld jʊɹ rɪˈsip/
dialogue.zh: 完成了，收據已經寄到您信箱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks for keeping it so easy.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks fɚ ˈkipɪŋ ɪt soʊ ˈizi/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝您把流程變得這麼輕鬆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our pleasure — enjoy the fried chicken!
dialogue.phonetic: /aʊɚ ˈplɛʒɚ ɛnˈdʒɔɪ ðə fɹaɪd ˈtʃɪkɪn/
dialogue.zh: 不客氣，炸雞好吃！

script.youtube_title: 【比價實戰】「你們會比照廣告價嗎？」氣炸鍋省錢記｜🎧60句聽力｜型號比對、破損折價、免費會員｜A2初級｜不用背多聽就會用｜Price Match Talk
script.youtube_title_en: "Do You Match Competitor Ads?" — Asking for a Price Match
script.youtube_description:
別家更便宜，可以讓商店照樣算錢嗎？這段「比價」美式英語聽力教你開口爭取！🎧

一位學生拿著手機截圖，想請店裡比照廣告價買氣炸鍋，結果發現兩家是不同容量、型號也不同。就在他要原價買下小台的時候，盒子上那道凹陷又出現新變化。店長怎麼處理？你會聽到完整的一來一往。

這一集重現家電區的比價對話：查廣告效期、比同款同規格、破損再折價、手機付款與免費會員，每句都不超過十個詞，A2 初級也能聽懂。

你會聽到：
🔸 開場詢問：Do you match competitor ads?
🔸 比價條件：Yes, if the item is exactly the same.
🔸 規格落差：Hmm, ours is the six-quart model.
🔸 破損折扣：Five dollars off — let me check my boss.

🎧 後半段是逐句聽力加跟讀練習，同一句先聽母語語調，再開口複製一次，把六十句的句子聽到會說。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背，多聽就會用，比價、折價、退差價的說法一次收集。

看完記得按讚、訂閱並打開小鈴鐺，每週新增一段生活情境聽力。留言告訴我們：你在國外比過價嗎？

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
script.youtube_description_en: Found it cheaper next door? Learn how to ask for a price match in real American English with this A2 listening practice. A student shows a store manager a screenshot of a paper ad, but the two fryers turn out to hold different sizes and carry different model numbers. Then a dented box adds a new twist. Listen to the whole exchange: checking if the ad is still good, comparing model numbers, choosing the smaller fryer, asking for a small discount on the dent, paying by phone, and opening a free app account. Every sentence stays under ten words, so it is easy to follow and repeat. The second half of the video is a sentence-by-sentence listen-and-repeat training to move the phrases from your ears to your mouth. Subscribe for a new daily-life dialogue every week and tell us: have you ever asked for a price match while traveling?
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🎧比價英文｜比照廣告價・型號比對・破損再折價｜聽完就能說｜🌱A2初級英文｜💡不用背多聽就會用
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
看到別家廣告更便宜，可以要求商店照樣算錢嗎？同款不同容量算不算一樣？盒子凹陷還能折扣嗎？
這一集帶大家走進賣場家電區，跟著一位學生用一張手機截圖，層層推進一場有禮的比價過程。
你會聽到：
🔸 開場詢問｜「Do you match competitor ads?」先確認政策再出示證據。
🔸 比價條件｜「Yes, if the item is exactly the same.」聽懂店家的同款同價要求。
🔸 規格落差｜「Hmm, ours is the six-quart model.」明白容量不同就不算同款。
🔸 破損折扣｜「Five dollars off — let me check my boss.」學會再壓一點價格的說法。

後半段是逐句聽力加跟讀練習 🎧 先聽母語語調，再開口複製，把六十句的比價英語聽到會說。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背，多聽就會用，下次看到報紙廣告就能開口問。

願你的每一塊錢都花得明明白白。
